visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bedroom with a clothing rack filled with garments in the background, a young woman with long black hair, wearing a navy and white striped shirt and denim shorts, sits at a white makeup desk. She looks at her reflection, touching her cheek with her hand, appearing to examine her skin while exhibiting a slightly frustrated expression. (2) A hand enters the frame from the right holding a white aerosol bottle. The woman reacts with a wide smile and surprised eyes, taking the bottle with both hands. She closes her eyes and sprays the mist onto her face, holding the bottle at arm's length while the fine mist covers her skin. (3) The scene shifts to a living room setup. The woman is seated on a grey couch with a golden-haired cocker spaniel dog resting on her lap. She is holding a black smartphone, looking towards someone off-camera and gesturing with her free hand towards the coffee table as if requesting something. (4) Two yellow, colorful packages of tissues featuring cartoon characters are held out toward her by a hand from off-screen. She reaches out excitedly with both hands to grab them, smiling broadly at the camera while the dog remains calm on her lap. (5) The woman is now in a kitchen area, standing before a large, grey LG refrigerator. She opens the top door, looks inside with a curious expression, and pulls out a carton of yellow-green soy milk, looking satisfied and gesturing with the product toward the camera. (6) Back on the sofa, she holds the soy milk carton while looking directly at the lens. A screen recording sequence of a mobile application named "uniopen" appears, displaying various sections like news, points, and shopping categories with colorful icons and promotional banners. (7) She holds her phone up to the camera, pointing at the screen which displays the uniopen app interface. She gestures with her hands as she speaks, appearing to explain the features and benefits. Various text overlays and comic-style graphic elements pop up around her head. (8) The video concludes with her sitting on the sofa, holding her phone and pointing at it while smiling vibrantly. She seems to be encouraging the viewer to download the app, ending with a cheerful and energetic expression before the final frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, youthful female voice speaks with a slightly whining, casual tone, complaining about dry skin. In the background, a high-tempo, upbeat acoustic guitar-driven pop track plays. The BGM has a steady, light drum beat and a major tonality, creating a cheerful atmosphere. (2) A sharp, continuous "psshhh" sound of an aerosol spray occurs for about one second. The female voice stops speaking during this sound effect. The background music continues at a consistent volume and tempo without any interruption. (3) The female voice lets out a bright, high-pitched exclamation of surprise, followed by a fast-paced question directed at a male presence. The male voice responds with a calm, neutral, and assertive tone, confirming he purchased the item. (4) A light "swish" transition sound effect occurs as the female voice mentions a lack of tissues. The acoustic BGM remains prominent with rhythmic strumming and a light percussion bed, maintaining an energetic and positive vibe as she speaks. (5) A dull, percussive thud and the rustling sound of plastic packaging are heard as the tissues are presented. The female voice reacts with another high-energy exclamation of surprise and delight. The male voice replies briefly with a short statement. (6) A metallic, mechanical click and the slight suction sound of a refrigerator door opening are audible. The female voice expresses surprise again, her pitch rising as she identifies a specific beverage. The male voice confirms his purchase with a steady tone. (7) A soft "bubble pop" sound effect signals a transition into a more narrative audio section. The female voice shifts into a structured, professional broadcasting style, clearly enunciating details about a digital platform called "uniopen" over the continuing upbeat BGM. (8) A series of digital "ding" and "pop" sound effects occur rapidly, coinciding with the mention of app features. The female narrator’s voice is high-arousal and energetic, emphasizing keywords like "shopping" and "points" with dynamic pitch changes. (9) A distinct notification-like chime sounds as the narrator explains a friend referral program. Her voice remains friendly and persuasive. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo, providing a constant layer of positive emotional energy under the information-heavy speech. (10) A final sequence of "pop" sound effects accompanies the mention of a leaderboard and points. The female and male voices engage in a short, upbeat dialogue. The music reaches its final phrase and fades out alongside their cheerful laughter and banter.
